title: The Reward Xiao Yan Needs
summary: Nalan Yanran asks Ya Fei to find an alchemist with a Heavenly Flame, because Gu He says only such a flame can draw the Searing Poison out of her grandfather Nalan Jie, and the Nalan Clan offers its treasures as a reward. Ya Fei shows Xiao Yan the reward list: it includes the Seven Magical Green Spirit Saliva, which restores Soul Power, so he decides to treat the old man despite his grudge, and she gives him an item that hides his scent. On his way he is ambushed by a Dou Huang who knows he is Xiao Yan of Wu Tan City; Xiao Yan holds him off with Octane Blast until Hai Bodong arrives and the attacker withdraws. Mite'er Tengshan strips Lei Ou of his post as Elder, sends him to a border city for three years and puts Ya Fei in charge of the headquarters auction house. Tengshan asks Hai Bodong to come home, but Hai Bodong says he must stay as Xiao Yan's guard for now. At the Nalan Residence, masked and calling himself Yan Xiao, Xiao Yan meets Nalan Su, who doubts that a second-tier alchemist can succeed where Gu He failed.
events: Nalan Yanran tells Ya Fei about the Searing Poison and Gu He's verdict that a Heavenly Flame is needed.
Ya Fei shows Xiao Yan the reward: the Seven Magical Green Spirit Saliva.
Ya Fei gives Xiao Yan a scent-hiding item for his visit to the Nalan Residence.
A hidden Dou Huang ambushes Xiao Yan; Hai Bodong arrives and the attacker leaves, calling him Ice Emperor.
Mite'er Tengshan demotes Lei Ou and makes Ya Fei head of the headquarters auction house.
Hai Bodong tells Tengshan he is bound to guard Xiao Yan for now.
Xiao Yan, as Yan Xiao, meets Nalan Su at the Nalan Residence.

469-481: the scent-hiding item is described in a remembered voice-over; its giver is most likely Ya Fei (who says 'you might need this' at 407) and its form (a mask) is inferred from EP37 1175.

Tengshan is called First Elder here and in EP36/EP44, but 'patriarch of the Mite'er family' in EP43.
1036-1053: Tengshan says 'your room' has been kept clean for Hai Bodong, implying Hai Bodong belongs to the Mite'er household; not explained.
